features.title: Offering catalog schema v2 alongside v1
features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/codex-parity-cp-01a.md: the v2 catalog validator (providers, permissionProfile, proofRefs, transports, workflow sha256) and the version-independent accessors providerImplementation, installEligible and nativeImplementationOf, with runtime.mjs PROFILES exported and imported, never copied. v1 validation and every OC-01 behavior stay unchanged. Do not change spec/offering-capabilities.json, install.sh, preflight semantics or any provider code.
acceptance: The production v1 catalog and its v2 form both validate; each listed v2 mutation is rejected with no input echoed and no hook run.
Accessors give identical answers for the v1 and v2 forms of all 46 offerings, and v2 answers come from providers.
loadOfferingCatalog, discoverOfferings and projectOfferingPreflight agree for the same offering in v1 and v2; readiness is never ready.

features.title: Shared Codex exec launcher
features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/codex-parity-cp-02a.md: core/skills/native-runtime/codex-exec.mjs with codexExecArgs (always --ignore-user-config), runCodexExec (detached process group, SIGTERM then SIGKILL after the grace, timeout 124, abort 130, CODEX_THREAD_ID removed, 0600 logs) and classifyCodexExec (fixed codes). autobuild and the hunt runner are not modified; the test compares against them as a drift detector. No real codex, network or HOME.
acceptance: For equal inputs the shared args match autobuild and the hunt runner on the fixed flag subset and always include --ignore-user-config.
Stub executables prove timeout 124, abort 130, SIGKILL after the grace and no surviving descendant.
Classification yields only the fixed codes, with PROVIDER_REFUSAL non-retryable, and CODEX_THREAD_ID never reaches the child.

features.title: Generic durable checkpoint store
features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/codex-parity-cp-02d.md: core/skills/native-runtime/checkpoint-store.mjs, createFileCheckpointStore({dir}) implementing exactly the reserve/settle/uncertain/close port runtime.mjs calls, with atomic 0600 per-call files in a 0700 directory and an exclusive lock that is never auto-broken. Held calls stay terminal (no reconcile command). runtime.mjs is not changed.
acceptance: A settled call replays the exact completion from a new store; prepared or uncertain calls return uncertain; a binding mismatch is CONFLICT.
Corrupt, truncated and read-only storage surface through the real runtime as CHECKPOINT_ERROR with zero provider calls.
A second store on the same directory is refused, a dead owner lock is never auto-broken, and close releases only its own lock.

features.title: Role file loader with skills inlining
features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/codex-parity-cp-03c.md: core/skills/native-runtime/role-files.mjs with listRoleFiles, loadRoleFile and assembleRoleInstructions over core/agents, kit/agents and graphs/*/agents, the exact frontmatter key set, fail-closed parsing and referenced SKILL.md bodies inlined once after the role body. The hunt runner is not modified.
acceptance: Every shipped role file parses with the frontmatter key set found on disk.
Unknown keys, a missing closing delimiter, duplicate roles, dangling skills and unsafe names fail closed with fixed codes and no input echoed.
The hunter assembly inlines the bug-lenses body exactly once after the role body, and the role body equals the hunt runner's strip.

features.title: Production catalog converted to v2 with a drift guard
features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/codex-parity-cp-01b.md: rewrite spec/offering-capabilities.json as v2 (same inventory, the pinned provider rows and three transports, workflow sha256, declared dependencies equal to the derived edges) and add checkCatalogDrift to core/skills/native-runtime/catalog.mjs, importing loadOfferingCatalog and role-files.mjs loadRoleFile, never copying. Change tests/native-catalog-v2.test.mjs only so productionV1 reads the OC-01 fixture. No change to install.sh, preflight, the validator, accessors or any SKILL.md; no supported value anywhere.
acceptance: The production catalog is v2 and valid with 46 offerings, 6 workflows, 46 assets and 4 fixed targets, the same inventory and derived values as the v1 snapshot, and every entrySha256, workflow sha256 and transport entry equal to the files on disk.

Declared dependencies are a superset of the edges derived from role skills frontmatter, skills/<name>/ mentions in entry SKILL.md and static core/skills imports; codex is partial only for autobuild and bughunt, and no provider row is supported.

checkCatalogDrift passes on the production root and, on a fixture root, reports a one-byte workflow change, each other drift and each undeclared edge with its fixed code, sorted, without writing anything.

features.title: Codex leaf provider on the NR-01 wire
features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/codex-parity-cp-02b.md: core/skills/native-runtime/codex-provider.mjs with createCodexProvider (frozen {runLeaf}), sandboxForProfile, CODEX_PROVIDER and CODEX_PROVIDER_CODES. runLeaf writes the runtime wireSchema to --output-schema, runs one codex exec through CP-02a's codexExecArgs/runCodexExec/classifyCodexExec (imported, never copied; --ignore-user-config always), and returns the {json} wire from --output-last-message as an NR-02 envelope. audit-source-only and release-controlled are refused before spawn. runtime.mjs, schema.mjs, codex-exec.mjs, autobuild and hunt are not modified. No real codex, network or HOME.
acceptance: The --output-schema file equals the runtime wireSchema, and a {"json":...} fixture yields a returned envelope that the real runtime accepts and decodes.

Every failure, including refusal, timeout, no output, non-wire and over-1 MiB output, gives a failed envelope with a fixed code and matching receipt after one spawn, and runLeaf never rejects after validation.
audit-source-only and release-controlled give PROFILE_UNSUPPORTED with zero spawns, no dollar field is emitted, and the prompt never reaches argv, the envelope or a provider-written file.

features.title: Codex install plan from the catalog
features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/codex-parity-cp-01c.md: core/skills/native-runtime/install-plan.mjs with installPlan({installationRoot, backend}) and its CLI (install-eligible offerings sorted by dest, transitive dependency sources checked, fixed codes), and install.sh --codex taking its targets, dest_of, --skip names and backup allow-check from one plan run. The installed set and Claude mode are unchanged; the catalog and tests/install-codex.test.mjs are not edited.
acceptance: install-plan prints exactly the two current dest<TAB>src lines for the repo, and tests/install-codex.test.mjs passes unchanged.
A fixture catalog's third eligible entry is linked once, honors --skip, and a conflict is backed up and restored by --uninstall, also under paths with spaces and colons.
A missing dependency source exits 2 with DEPENDENCY_MISSING, empty stdout and an untouched target, and uninstall never restores a manifest entry outside the plan.

features.title: Offering inspection and a provider-keyed preflight gate
features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/codex-parity-cp-01d.md: core/skills/native-runtime/inspect-offering.mjs with inspectOffering (nine fixed checks, drift only from catalog.mjs checkCatalogDrift, ready only with an injected probe, probe called at most once and only after every static check passes, probe timeout) and CLAUDE_ONLY_CONTROLS; and in preflight-cli.mjs make IMPLEMENTATION_NOT_CERTIFIED read providerImplementation(offering, backend) for v2 catalogs while v1 keeps today's rule. No CLI flag or output change, no model or effort table, no process started by the inspection itself, no catalog, accessor or install.sh change.
acceptance: An unavailable provider row, a missing binary, entry drift and a missing dependency each give unsupported with zero probe calls; a throwing probe gives unknown, and no probe never gives ready.

ready requires an injected probe that reports model, effort and concurrency supported (wiring proof), and each of the six Claude-only caps under codex gives unsupported with UNSUPPORTED_CONTROL and zero probe calls.
v1 preflight CLI cases are unchanged, v2 refusals are keyed on providers.<backend>, and offline inspection and CLI runs start no process (spawn spy and PATH stubs).

features.title: Role-to-profile table and Codex leaf selection
features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/codex-parity-cp-02c.md: core/skills/native-runtime/codex-selection.mjs with ROLE_PROFILES, CODEX_REFUSED_WORKFLOWS and resolveLeaf, importing CODEX_PROVIDER and sandboxForProfile (CP-02b), codexExecArgs (CP-02a), autobuild codexModel and DOCTOR_EFFORTS, never copying; add the DOCTOR_EFFORTS export to core/skills/run-records/doctor.mjs. No change to runtime.mjs, the provider, the catalog, role files, autobuild or hunt.
acceptance: Every role in every catalog workflow row has exactly one profile row matching the role files: Edit or Write gives build-workspace, checker is the only other build-workspace role, and the runner has no profile.
Release and audit roles, any leaf of release-flow or security-audit-flow, and the hunt runner give INVALID_SELECTION through the real runtime with zero reserves and zero provider calls.

Models map through autobuild codexModel (sonnet, fable, haiku to gpt-6.1-sol, gpt-6-astra, gpt-6-luna), an unmapped claude-* model or an effort outside DOCTOR_EFFORTS is refused with no echo, and the runtime's PROFILE_REFUSED still fires for a resolver that returns a refused profile.

features.title: Provider-neutral SKILL_DIR helper invocation
features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/codex-parity-cp-03a.md: rewrite the fenced helper commands in core/skills/{backlog,findings,gtm-brief,verify}/SKILL.md to the pinned idiom "${SKILL_DIR:-${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}}/<helper>" with the pinned paragraph and no .claude path, and update exactly those four entrySha256 values in spec/offering-capabilities.json. No helper code, install.sh, catalog row or other SKILL.md changes.
acceptance: Every fenced helper command in the four SKILL.md files uses the pinned SKILL_DIR idiom with the documented fallback paragraph, and no file names a .claude path.

The documented commands give their documented exits from a Codex-layout symlink in a clean HOME with no .claude, and the same exits and verdicts as main's commands in a Claude layout; verify reports capture: direct only off Linux (D123).
The four entrySha256 values equal the edited SKILL.md bytes and checkCatalogDrift stays ok.

features.title: Native graph host library and CLI
features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/codex-parity-cp-02e.md: add core/skills/native-runtime/graph-host.mjs exporting runGraphHost and the --args-file CLI. It takes workflow pins from the v2 catalog, refuses before creating anything, puts role instructions in front of each leaf prompt, uses the CP-02d store and its lock, and writes result.json. No catalog, workflow, role file, runtime, registry, provider, selection or store changes.
acceptance: A pin mismatch (REGISTRY_MISMATCH), a v1 catalog (CATALOG_NO_PINS), an unlisted workflow (UNKNOWN_WORKFLOW) and a codex-unavailable offering (OFFERING_UNSUPPORTED) each exit 2 with no checkpoint, no provider call and no run directory; a bad args file exits 1 with one JSON error line.

A harness-repair run with a fake provider writes result.json (0600) when the graph returns and exits 0 with the graph status, escalate included, only when both closes succeed; a close failure after the write exits 3 and leaves result.json in place; a provider throw or the runtime deadline exits 3 with no result.json, and a held run lock exits 4 and is never broken.
On resume a completed leaf replays with no provider call, an uncertain leaf is held with CHECKPOINT_UNCERTAIN, and a new invocation id starts fresh.

features.title: Reference-content closure
features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/codex-parity-cp-03b.md: in spec/offering-capabilities.json add dev -> harness-review and verify, bughunt -> backlog, release-pr -> backlog (sorted), and GUIDANCE_ONLY under both providers of the seven shared-reference-contract rows. No SKILL.md, role, workflow, module or other catalog change.
acceptance: Every skills: name in a shipped role file resolves to a catalog entry offering whose SKILL.md is a regular file matching its entrySha256.
The six lenses in intake routing (ALWAYS plus SIGNALS) equal the files in core/skills/bug-lenses/lenses, the skill table, the hunt workflow lists and findings LENSES.

Declared dependencies cover child-workflow and role-body closure edges, and the reference rows stay non-supported and carry GUIDANCE_ONLY under both providers, while install-plan output and checkCatalogDrift stay unchanged.
